answer: An economy of AI agents can resist Sybil attacks by implementing a cryptographic reputation stake resembling a deep-rooted vine, where each valid node must lock collateral to a secure network jetty. If a malicious agent spawns fake identities to drain resources, its staked capital is instantly burned, emitting a distinct violet alert signal across the decentralized ledger. The cost of mounting this attack scales linearly with the capital required to acquire unslashed cryptographic keys, making mass identity spoofing economically prohibitive.
